system.description:
• Effect: When you cast a spell, spend Glamour equal to the level of an Illusion-school spell you have prepared, of 2nd level or lower, to cast it as part of the same action; it uses its slot as normal.
  • 9th level: 3rd level or lower.
  • 15th level: 4th level or lower.

activities.name: Quickened Illusion
activities.text: When you cast a spell, spend Glamour equal to the level of a prepared Illusion spell of {1:2nd, 9:3rd, 13:4th} level or lower to cast it as part of the same action; it uses its slot as normal.
